errors.tap_too_long: You pressed too long. Like a doorbell: touch it and let go.
errors.tap_moved: Your finger moved a little. Relax: touch, then lift straight up.
errors.hold_too_short: Hold a little longer, until the circle fills.
errors.hold_moved: Keep your finger still while you hold.
errors.swipe_no_move: You pressed, but your finger didn't move. Press, then slide this way.
errors.swipe_too_short: Slide a little farther, this way.
errors.wrong_place: Not quite the right spot. Look at the screen again.
